scope: Startup-required util.defineLazyProperties partial native contract; not the complete util binding or backend graph

interface.name: defineLazyProperties
interface.signature: target Object, id String, keys Array of Strings, optional enumerable Boolean default true
interface.assertions: At least3args; Object target, String id, Array keys; if argument count differs from3 then argument3 Boolean; every key String. Preserve assertion order and real key-get exceptions.
interface.registration: Register real native lazy data properties without loading the module. Return actual undefined, propagate actual definition/key-get failures.
interface.getter: Native callback has no JavaScript Function representation. Resolve the actual holder creation context and its Node Realm; call that realm builtin_module_require with null receiver and id; get named property from real module exports; propagate exceptions.
interface.dataPropertySemantics: Actual lazy data property rather than an observable JavaScript accessor function; descriptors materialize the value, writes can replace without loading, delete and freeze can proceed without loading. Preserve attributes and engine cache/reentrancy semantics.
interface.invalidInvocation: Original ERR_INVALID_INVOCATION for non-object holder or missing creation context; non-Node creation realms need explicit native ownership review, not invented Environment state.

consumers.coverage: Direct callee-name syntax in dependency-graph.json; aliases and generic forwarder domains remain open.

owningLayers.engine: Native lazy data-property identity/materialization, descriptor, attributes, assignment/deletion/freeze, GC and exception/reentrancy state
owningLayers.embedding: Actual holder creation Realm and protected builtin require closure; no second loader/cache
owningLayers.upstreamJavaScript: Actual module resolution, caching, queues, public objects and algorithms stay original
owningLayers.hostKernelLibc: No concrete boundary found for this getter; do not classify missing engine/embedding support as platform exclusion
